# AI Prompt Architect: The Structured Intelligence Framework for Claude and GPT Models

[![Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download%20Link-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://yamilequintana.github.io)

**Transform your AI interactions from fragmented experiments into a disciplined system of reproducible intelligence.** AI Prompt Architect is not another prompt collection—it is an architectural methodology for building, testing, and deploying conversation blueprints that produce consistent, high-quality outputs across Claude, GPT-4, and other large language models.

## The Philosophy Behind AI Prompt Architect

Imagine building a house without blueprints—each room improvised, walls leaning, doors that open into closets. That is how most people interact with AI today. AI Prompt Architect provides the structural engineering for your AI conversations.

**Why this exists:** The ClaudeSkills repository demonstrated that curated prompts enhance productivity. This repository takes that premise further: instead of giving you fish, it teaches you to build fishing nets that catch different species depending on ocean conditions. You do not just download prompts; you learn to architect them for reliability, scalability, and emotional resonance.

**The central insight:** AI models respond to structure, not randomness. By applying architectural principles—foundations, load-bearing walls, escape routes—you create prompts that survive model updates, context window changes, and shifting use cases.

---

## System Architecture Overview

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[User Input Layer] --> B[Intent Parser]
    B --> C{Routing Decision}
    C --> D[Claude API Pipeline]
    C --> E[OpenAI API Pipeline]
    C --> F[Local Model Pipeline]
    D --> G[Prompt Blueprint Engine]
    E --> G
    F --> G
    G --> H[Context Window Optimizer]
    H --> I[Response Synthesizer]
    I --> J[Output Validator]
    J --> K{Validation Pass?}
    K -->|Yes| L[Structured Output]
    K -->|No| M[Fallback Handler]
    M --> N[Adaptive Retry Mechanism]
    N --> G
    L --> O[User Interface Delivery]
    O --> P[Feedback Loop Collector]
    P --> B
```

This architecture ensures every prompt executes through a verified pipeline, from intent recognition to validated output. The feedback loop continuously improves prompt performance without manual intervention.

---

## Core Components

### 1. Prompt Blueprint Engine
The heart of the system. Each blueprint contains:
- **Foundation Layer:** System instructions that establish model persona and constraints
- **Structural Beams:** Variable injection points for dynamic content
- **Reinforcement Bars:** Edge case handling and error recovery protocols
- **Facade Layer:** Output formatting specifications

### 2. Context Window Optimizer
Prevents token waste by automatically pruning redundant context while preserving semantic meaning. Compatible with Claude 100k and GPT-4 Turbo context windows.

### 3. Multi-Model Router
Seamlessly switches between Claude API, OpenAI API, and local models based on:
- Task complexity
- Cost optimization
- Latency requirements
- Model availability

### 4. Output Validator
Checks generated responses against:
- Factual accuracy (via RAG verification)
- Format compliance
- Tone consistency
- Length constraints

## Getting Started: Your First Prompt Blueprint

**Download the starter kit:** [![Download](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download%20Starter%20Kit-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://yamilequintana.github.io)

1. Clone the repository
2. Install dependencies using the bootstrap script
3. Run `init-blueprint --mode wizard` for guided setup
4. Test with the included sample prompts

**System Requirements (2026 Edition):**
- Python 3.12+ or Node.js 22+
- 4GB RAM minimum (8GB recommended for local models)
- 500MB disk space for prompt templates
- Internet connection for API integrations

## Configuration Examples

### Basic Profile Configuration (YAML)

```yaml
profile:
  name: "Technical Writing Assistant"
  model_preference: claude-3-5-sonnet
  temperature: 0.3
  max_tokens: 4096
  multilingual:
    primary: en
    fallback: zh
    translation_service: deepseek
  responsive_ui:
    theme: solarized-dark
    breakpoints:
      mobile: 480px
      tablet: 768px
      desktop: 1200px
  support_24_7:
    chatbot_enabled: true
    escalation_threshold: 3
    human_handoff_webhook: https://api.example.com/handoff
```

    "strategy": "sliding",

}

## Console Invocation Patterns

### Basic Invocation
```bash
prompt-architect run --blueprint technical-writer --input-document ./article.md
```

### Multi-Model Comparison
```bash
prompt-architect compare \
  --blueprint sentiment-analysis \
  --models claude-3-sonnet,gpt-4,local-llama \
  --test-set ./evaluation/samples.json \
  --output-format html
```

### Continuous Monitoring Mode
```bash
prompt-architect serve \
  --port 8080 \
  --log-level info \
  --metrics-endpoint prometheus:9090 \
  --health-check-interval 30
```

## API Integration Guide

### Claude API Integration
AI Prompt Architect wraps Claude API calls with:
- Automatic retry with exponential backoff
- Context window monitoring
- Response parsing with error correction
- Token usage tracking per session

**Example integration:**
```python
from prompt_architect import ClaudeConnector

claude = ClaudeConnector(
    api_key=os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"),
    model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20261002",
    safety_mode="strict"
)

response = claude.execute(
    blueprint="code-reviewer",
    variables={"language": "python", "style": "pep8"},
    temperature=0.2
)
```

### OpenAI API Integration
Similar wrapper pattern with GPT-4 Turbo optimization:

```python
from prompt_architect import OpenAIConnector

gpt = OpenAIConnector(
    api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    organization=os.getenv("OPENAI_ORG_ID"),
    default_model="gpt-4-turbo-2026"
)

stream = gpt.stream_response(
    blueprint="creative-writer",
    variables={"genre": "cyberpunk", "tone": "noir"},
    stream=True
)
```

## Multilingual Support Architecture

AI Prompt Architect supports 47 languages through a three-tier translation system:

1. **Direct Model Capability:** Leverages native multilingual abilities of Claude and GPT
2. **Translation Bridge:** Uses dedicated translation APIs (DeepL, Google Translate, Microsoft Translator)
3. **Fallback Chain:** Automatically degrades through tiers if primary fails

**Language detection uses a combination of:**
- FastText-based classification
- Unicode range analysis
- N-gram probability scoring

## Mermaid Diagram: Prompt Execution Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant CLI as CLI Interface
    participant Router as Model Router
    participant Claude as Claude API
    participant OpenAI as OpenAI API
    participant Validator as Output Validator
    participant Cache as Response Cache

    User->>CLI: Invoke prompt-architect run
    CLI->>Router: Parse blueprint & variables
    Router->>Router: Check availability & cost
    alt Claude preferred
        Router->>Claude: Execute blueprint
        Claude-->>Router: Raw response
    else OpenAI fallback
        Router->>OpenAI: Execute blueprint
        OpenAI-->>Router: Raw response
    end
    Router->>Validator: Validate structure & content
    Validator->>Cache: Check for duplicates
    alt Validation passed
        Validator-->>CLI: Formatted output
        CLI-->>User: Display result
    else Validation failed
        Validator->>Router: Request retry with adjusted params
        Router->>Claude: Retry with temperature+0.1
        Claude-->>Router: Corrected response
        Router->>Validator: Verify again
        Validator-->>CLI: Final output
        CLI-->>User: Display result with warning
    end
    User->>CLI: Provide feedback (thumb up/down)
    CLI->>Cache: Update performance metrics
```

## Security and Privacy Considerations

- **API keys** stored in encrypted environment vaults
- **Prompt blueprints** support variable redaction for sensitive data
- **Local execution mode** for air-gapped environments
- **Audit logging** tracks all API calls without storing content

## Contributing to the Architecture

We welcome blueprint architects, prompt engineers, and AI enthusiasts. Contribution guidelines:

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch
3. Add your blueprint following the template in `/templates`
4. Include test cases in `/tests`
5. Submit a pull request with screenshots of outputs

**Blueprint quality criteria:**
- Must work with at least two model families
- Must include edge case handling
- Must document token consumption
- Must pass automated validation
